name: Procurement Auction
summary: A reverse auction where buyers compete to sell a contract to an auctioneer, with the lowest bidder winning.
rules_text: There is one buyer (auctioneer) and N sellers (bidders). Each seller has a private cost for fulfilling the contract. Sellers simultaneously submit sealed bids representing the price at which they will fulfill it. The auctioneer purchases from the lowest bidder. In a first-price procurement auction, the winner is paid their own bid. In a second-price procurement auction, the winner is paid the second-lowest bid. Variants can be run as descending English auctions where price falls until one bidder remains, or Dutch auctions. The winner profits by the payment minus their true cost; losers get zero. All bidders know the rules but not others' costs.
rating_reason: Reverse auction: lowest bid wins, private values, strategic bidding, easily turn-based text
